problem: External backup coordination disabled backup controls without progress or cancellation while a provider prepared the file.
changes: Both apps show Opening backup with a Cancel action and unchanged-work guidance outside the disabled controls.
A per-read operation can cancel active NSFileCoordinator waits, checks cancellation before accepting bytes, and balances security-scoped access.
Read identity guards ignore late results/errors and prevent an old operation from clearing a newer operation’s busy state.
Workspace changes cancel pending reads; reappearance in the same workspace does not cancel them.

verification.realFoundationRegression: HoldingBackupPresenter withholds its save completion. Cancel returns NSUserCancelledError before releasing that presenter; source bytes stay identical and a new read returns the original backup.
verification.preCancelledRead: Returns cancellation; independent retry succeeds without modifying the file.
verification.backupSuites: 45 tests per repo, 90 total, zero failures. Includes stale-presenter coordination, permission failure, missing-file retry, oversized-file rejection and existing backup/restore safeguards.
verification.builds: Both final Debug app targets build for arm64 macOS / iOS Simulator with signing disabled; no app installed.

limitations: New progress/Cancel interface and late-result behavior have not yet been exercised in a native app workflow.
Actual offline cloud-provider download/retry remains unaccepted; the regression uses a real local NSFilePresenter.
No distribution signing or full P0 acceptance claim.

cleanup.apps: No Taskfold/preview apps launched this turn; none running at verification.
